## Analysis overview

Selects safety subjects with treatment-emergent serious events, counts affected subjects and events overall and by event hierarchy, calculates treatment percentages, and adds comparison p-values.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADAE`
- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `USUBJID`: subject identifier
- `SAFFL`: safety flag
- `TRTEMFL`: treatment-emergent flag
- `AESER`: serious adverse event flag
- `AEBODSYS`: system organ class
- `AETERM`: event term
- `TRTA/TRTAN`: actual treatment
- `TRT01P/TRT01PN in ADSL`: denominator treatment.
